base: claude/s81u-svc-1017 97c52bae0 (monolithic dsdv_svc_sx, 6,420 lane pins per face)

centre_leaf.why: no lane mixes rows: the node adds lane (r,h)+(r,h); scatter shifts head slots identically per row -> 4 independent row exchanges, bit-identical
centre_leaf.tag: 20-b tag carried as 4 x 5-b parts, part r in row r; operand tag check covers all 20 bits across the 4 leaves
centre_leaf.pins_registered: every input lands in a flop, every output leaves a flop

depth.out: NR+1 = 2 (A at ~1/4 hop, B at slice edge)

relay_stations.per_slice: 4 rows x 4 faces x 3 stations x 3 deep = 144 instances (edge slices of the 2x8 grid may omit unused faces)
relay_stations.spare_bits: 18 per gather pair, 6 per scatter station, constant 0

split.hop_geometry: p4h slices 1,222 x 1,338 um; leaf pin -> A -> B -> C -> leaf pin spans <= one slice pitch (inner faces of the 2x2 leaf cluster sit on the centre line): 4 segments <= 335 um <= 405 um planning reach

cycles.note: identical pipeline to the monolith (in: C + leaf pin flop; out: leaf centre reg + A + B); role ROM offsets unchanged. dv_price: no change from the S81U-SVC +12 cyc/job estimate.

bench.mutskew: FAIL root err 600, taps err 9600, fault slice 4

kit: physical/ref_tile/dsdv_svc_sx_hrow (spec tools/ref_tile/specs_s81dv_svcx/dsdv_svc_sx_hrow.json; CTS settings of gate 3 kept); dsdv_svc_sx_row kit removed (never routed)

svcx4.why: the one-row leaf dsdv_svc_sx_row (14,383 sinks, 388.8 sq) measured at its best CTS (gate 3, c603d2060) TT 326.4..415.3 ps insertion / 88.9 ps spread, over the 300/80 clock rule; structural fix = halve the leaf

centre_leaf.partition: head parity: half b of row r = heads 2i+b (8 qaddf); gather never mixes heads
centre_leaf.scatter_crossing_check: node shifts head slots by its left size 8/4/2/1; 8/4/2 keep slot parity (local 4/2/1), only the pair nodes' shift by 1 crosses -> pair nodes no longer shift; the leaf of head t taps local slot 0 of half t[0] (role head bit 0); the non-owning half's tap register holds 0 and the slice ORs the 2 taps. Nothing crosses halves; scatter lane slot order below a pair node is internal to the exchange

svcx4.relay_stations: per face and row: gather 2 stations (one per half, 270 b + 6 spare), scatter 1 station (the 2 halves' 138 b, 0 spare); same 144 per slice

cycles.note: pipeline unchanged; role ROM unchanged (pair-node shift handled in the leaf RTL)
